description: This source file implements Python bindings for torch type information classes (finfo and iinfo), including their creation, comparison, and property access, using the Python C-API.

classes.name: THPFInfo
classes.description: Python binding class for floating point info (finfo), providing properties like epsilon, max, min, etc.

classes.name: THPIInfo
classes.description: Python binding class for integer info (iinfo), providing properties like max, min, and dtype.

methods.name: THPFInfo_pynew
methods.description: Constructor for finfo objects, parsing arguments to create a new finfo instance.

methods.name: THPIInfo_pynew
methods.description: Constructor for iinfo objects, parsing arguments to create a new iinfo instance.

methods.name: THPDTypeInfo_compare
methods.description: Comparison method for type info objects, supporting equality and inequality.

methods.name: THPDTypeInfo_bits
methods.description: Returns the number of bits for the type.

methods.name: THPFInfo_eps
methods.description: Returns the epsilon value for the floating point type.

methods.name: THPFInfo_max
methods.description: Returns the maximum representable value for the floating point type.

methods.name: THPFInfo_min
methods.description: Returns the lowest (most negative) value for the floating point type.

methods.name: THPFInfo_smallest_normal
methods.description: Returns the smallest normal positive value for the floating point type.

methods.name: THPFInfo_tiny
methods.description: Returns the smallest normal positive value, same as smallest_normal.

methods.name: THPFInfo_resolution
methods.description: Returns the resolution (digits10) of the floating point type.

methods.name: THPFInfo_dtype
methods.description: Returns the data type name of the floating point type.

methods.name: THPFInfo_str
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the finfo object.

methods.name: THPIInfo_max
methods.description: Returns the maximum value for the integer type.

methods.name: THPIInfo_min
methods.description: Returns the minimum value for the integer type.

methods.name: THPIInfo_dtype
methods.description: Returns the data type name of the integer type.

methods.name: THPIInfo_str
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the iinfo object.
